name: Forbidden Confessions: Charm
source:
My Lucky Charm entails the confession story of Keith, a 26-year-old man living alone in an apartment in Charlotte, North Carolina. 

One day, a mysterious girl named Hailey arrived at Keith's doorstep, which eventually lead to a series of encounters and affairs.

Is Hailey's arrival a misfortune or the product of something else?

[From [url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/forbidden-confessions-charm]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《My Lucky Charm》讲述了基思的自白故事。他26岁，独自住在美国北卡罗来纳州夏洛特的一间公寓里。

某天，一位名叫海莉的神秘女孩出现在基思家门前，随后引出了一连串相遇与私情。

海莉的到来，究竟是不幸，还是另有缘由？

[摘自[url=https://strange-girl-studios.itch.io/forbidden-confessions-charm]itch.io[/url]]
